It makes tablets, capsules, soft-gels, liquid orals, ointments/creams, sachets and cosmetics across gynaecology, haematinic, cardio-diabetic, orthopaedic, paediatric, derma-cosmetic, antibiotic, CNS, vitamins and nutrients.
